However, leverage is high (total liabilities of 91,085M versus equity of 23,793M, i.e., liabilities-to-equity ~3.8), and liquidity is only moderate (current ratio 1.55), which constrains credit strength and keeps the rating below investment grade.  

DECISION: BB+
